recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. No current-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-25474; future GraphDefinition maintenance, including FHIR-41494 invariants, should be handled in HL7/api-incubator-ig or whichever repository owns the API Incubator GraphDefinition artifact.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request for R5 asking GraphDefinition to describe an actual graph rather than a tree by using node definitions, edge relationships, an optional root/start node, and reference-instance constraint structures.
initial_application: Core commit 93e0bc90e3a80969bae01ab57e37a0cb9221ee68 applied the redesign by changing GraphDefinition.start to a node id, adding GraphDefinition.node/nodeId/type/profile, adding GraphDefinition.link.sourceId and targetId, moving compartment rules to link level, and removing the recursive link.target backbone.
additional_context: Zulip and FHIR-I minutes from 2019-2020 support the same true-graph/node-edge rationale, and 2022-09 WGM minutes show the data-structure details were carried forward before the December 2022 implementation. Current R6 core removed source/graphdefinition in commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd and source/conformance-module.html now points GraphDefinition to the API Incubator. The current HL7/api-incubator-ig source preserves GraphDefinition.start, node.nodeId, link.sourceId, and link.targetId. Later FHIR-41494 asks for additional invariants tying those ids together, but it is Resolved - change required rather than Applied/Published and belongs with the external artifact.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because FHIR-25474 was already applied before GraphDefinition moved out of the current core build.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - change required issue asking to enforce that GraphDefinition.start, link.sourceId, and link.targetId refer to declared node.nodeId values; it refines the FHIR-25474 model but is not in the default Applied/Published source-edit scope and belongs with the external GraphDefinition source.
